locate() places a passage by its first text match: a sentence repeated earlier in the same section gets the earlier offset, and a passage that cannot be placed is dropped rather than guessed.

results.notes: Built the long-page reader behind MODEL_GATEWAY_WEB_READER (strict literal-true parser, default off). page_reader.rs is pure: outline (Markdown headings, or read-sized windows without headings; at most 40 sections), section reads paged by character offset (4,000 per read), and find built on grounding::select_passages run per section, with each passage placed in its section. tool_loop.rs: the fetch_url arm returns outline, ref, first chunk and note only when a page was parked and the reader is on; read_page and find_in_page arms resolve through the tenant-keyed handle store (same tenancy as result_query), require RESULT_HANDLES_EXTENDED and a turn that is neither ZDR nor waived, and return parked provenance through read_back_provenance, so flagged pages keep their SCREENING label. The reader tools are offered per turn only beside fetch_url and only where a page can be parked; with the switch off the tool list, the dispatch (unknown-tool error) and the retrieval-scope filter are unchanged. The outline gives way one row at a time so the whole result fits MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_CHARS, because serde_json sorts keys and ref would otherwise be cut. No proto, migration or SSE change. Two rows added to the posture matrix (30 rows) with a schema-loader pass and Rust decision pass.
